facebookAccount.notes: Time the system automatically retrieves new cookies from email/password, unit is minute. If set to null, the system will not automatically retrieve new cookies. Warning: setting this causes a full bot restart every N minutes which drops all active sessions. Leave as null unless you are specifically using email/password authentication and understand the impact.

notesLanguage: Change to your language with ISO 639-1 code. Available languages: vi (Vietnamese), en (English)
noPrefixNotes: When true, Bot Admins (role 2) and Developers (role 4) can run commands without the prefix
notes_premiumUsers: List of user IDs with premium access (role 3)
notes_devUsers: List of developer IDs with full access (role 4)

whiteListMode.notes: If enabled, only the IDs in the whiteListIds list can use the bot

whiteListModeThread.notes: If enabled, only the threads in the whiteListThreadIds list can use the bot
whiteListModeThread.how_it_work: If both whiteListMode and whiteListModeThread are enabled, the system will check if the user is in whiteListIds, then check if the thread is in whiteListThreadIds. If one of the conditions is true, the user can use the bot

database.notes: (1) Type selects 'json', 'sqlite', or 'mongodb'. If you choose mongodb, enter the URI connection string in the uriMongodb section. Instructions to get MongoDB URI at: https://youtu.be/z1f9urHW5xY. I recommend using 'mongodb' or 'sqlite'. JSON is not recommended because it is not stable. (2) When autoSyncWhenStart is set to true, the bot will automatically synchronize the data in the database when starting, which will make the bot start slower. (3) When autoRefreshThreadInfoFirstTime is set to true, the bot will automatically refresh thread information when it receives the first message from the thread after starting.

spamProtection.notes: Auto-ban threads when users spam commands. commandThreshold: number of commands, timeWindow: seconds, banDuration: hours

autoRestart.notes: Set time as interval in milliseconds or cron time. Examples: 1000, 10000, 60000, 3600000, 86400000, 0 0 * * *, etc. Documentation: https://www.npmjs.com/package/node-cron. If time is set to 0, false, or null, the bot will not auto restart

autoUptime.notes: timeInterval value is in seconds. URL is the endpoint to send requests to (automatically detected for Glitch or Replit hosting)

autoLoadScripts.notes: This feature will automatically load scripts when they have been changed. Set ignoreCmds to ignore commands and ignoreEvents to ignore events, separated by comma or space. Example: 'cmd1.js cmd2.js cmd3.js'

restartListenMqtt.notes: timeRestart and delayAfterStopListening values are in milliseconds. You should not edit this unless you understand what it does

notiWhenListenMqttError.notes: This is the message when the bot is listening to the MQTT server and the server stops working due to account problems such as: locked account, blocked due to spam, etc. The bot will automatically send notifications to your configured destinations. Set enable to true to use this feature. See bot/login/handlerWhenListenHasError.js for details on how it works

telegram.note: Can send notifications to multiple chat IDs, separated by comma or space. Example: '123456789 987654321'

discordHook.note: Can send notifications to multiple webhook URLs, separated by comma or space. Example: 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123456789/123456789 https://discord.com/api/webhooks/987654321/987654321'

typingIndicator.notes: Shows typing indicator before sending messages. Duration is in milliseconds (1000 = 1 second). Set enable to false to disable.
